build_inputs.angles:
Same power as the V8 it replaced, and 125 lb-ft more torque. The old RS5
had a 4.2 naturally aspirated V8 making about 450 hp but only ~317 lb-ft.
The 2.9 twin-turbo V6 makes 444 hp and 443 lb-ft — and all of it from 1,900 rpm.
Audi quotes 0-60 in 3.9 seconds. Testers have got 3.3 out of it. The
company undersells its own car.
The complaint that sticks is the noise. Reviewers found the V6 flat and
characterless next to the V8 — faster, duller.
The Sportback body didn't exist before. The previous RS5 was coupe and
convertible only; five doors with the same performance is new.
174 mph top speed.

history.fact: Audi released the Sportback variant of the second-gen A5 in 2018, debuting a new fastback design.

scenes.headline: 3.3 Seconds 0-60
scenes.narration: Zero to sixty in a mere 3.3 seconds. Most people have no idea it’s this quick. That's the 2023 Audi RS5 Sportback.

scenes.headline: Fastback Design
scenes.narration: In 2018, Audi released the Sportback variant, bringing a sleek fastback design to the A5 lineup. This RS5 is the top-tier offering.

scenes.headline: 2.9L V6 Power
scenes.narration: The 2.9-liter twin-turbo V6 pushes out 444 horsepower and 443 pound-feet of torque. That’s almost immediate power from just 1,900 rpm. And it matches the old V8's power output.

scenes.headline: Quattro AWD
scenes.narration: Audi's Quattro system ensures everything hits the ground with precision. Paired with an 8-speed automatic, it delivers seamless power delivery.

scenes.headline: Luxury Features
scenes.narration: Inside, luxury abounds. With Fine Nappa leather, a Bang & Olufsen sound system, and even massaging front seats, comfort is front and center.

scenes.headline: Price Drop
scenes.narration: Originally priced around $87K new. Now, these go for about $72K. It's a prime example of luxury meeting performance value.
But is the faster, quieter V6 enough to overlook its loss of character compared to the old V8's soulful growl? Where do you stand?

sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2023 Audi RS5 Sportback, finished in Nardo Gray with a black interior. The odometer on this RS5 displays about 5,000 miles. The attached Carfax history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this Audi’s past. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, factory equipment includes the Black Optic, Dynamic, RS Driver Assistance, Navigation, and Side Assist packages, LED headlights, a panoramic sunroof, Fine Nappa leather upholstery, heated and massaging front seats, heated rear seats, a Bang & Olufsen 3D sound system, and more as detailed below. Modifications reported by the seller are limited to 20-inch BBS wheels, tinted windows, and paint protection film on the door edges. Audi released the Sportback variant of the second-generation A5 for 2018. It was to the A4 what the A6 was to the A7: it was closely related to its sedan counterpart underneath the sheet metal, but it stood out with a swoopy, fastback-like silhouette. The RS5 is the top-of-the-line version of the A5, sporting large brakes, sportier suspension, and a muscular look that sets it apart visually from the standard trim. Power comes from a 2.9-liter twin-turbocharged V6, rated at 444 horsepower and 443 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to all four wheels via an 8-speed automatic transmission and Audi's Quattro permanent all-wheel drive system.
